title: adenostemma lavenia var. angustifolium
intro: Adenostemma lavenia var. angustifolium, commonly known as 'Kamana' in the Philippines, is a medicinal plant species belonging to the family Goodeniaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Adenostemma lavenia var. angustifolium are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant, antiviral, and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic efficacy.
